evals.prompt: Run a controlled comparison while helping me draft a 700-word incident retrospective for a mixed technical and nontechnical audience. Use the fixed Planning, Translating, then Reviewing order and keep the same .writing state across passes.
evals.expected_output: The Monitor delegates Planning, Translating, and Reviewing to fresh role agents in that order, starts every further pass with Planning, writes only .writing/history.md, and stops only after a Reviewing pass.
expectations: Starts each pass with Planning, then moves to Translating and Reviewing.
Delegates every process to a fresh role agent and writes nothing but .writing/history.md.
Delegates an accepted goal replacement to the next pass's Planning and stops only after Reviewing.
